piezas.titulo: Reading words: Study and daily work
texto: Reading and spelling of academic and office terms: «ประชุม» has the mid-class consonant ป with the short vowel a and the low-class consonant ช with the vowel ุ (mid tone). «การบ้าน» combines the nominalising prefix «การ» with «บ้าน» (falling tone). «ส่ง» has the high-class consonant ส with the mark ่ (low tone). «อธิบาย» is a formal loanword with the initial consonant อ, the low-class consonant ธิ (high tone) and บาย (mid tone). Reading these words helps you understand work emails and study timetables.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ส่ง» (to hand in / to send), what tone results from the high-class consonant ส with the mark ่ (mái eek)?

opciones.texto: Low tone (เสียงเอก)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: a high-class consonant with the sign ่ always produces a low tone.
Incorrect: in high class, the sign ่ does not produce a high tone.
Incorrect: it would need the sign ้.
